learning_outcomes.text: Basic knowledge on Fourier analysis (continuous- and discrete-time signals) and linear systems.
Introduction to ISO-OSI model and TCP/IP protocols.

syllabus_topics: Analysis in the frequency domain of deterministic time-continuous signals
Fourier transform of distributions (generalized functions), step signals and periodic signals
Analysis in the frequency domain of deterministic time-discrete signals
Impulse response and transfer function of time-invarying linear systems
Cross and auto correlation functions of deterministic signals
Introduction; analogue modulations (AM, PM, FM, DSB-SC, QAM)
Power spectra of deterministic PAM signals
Bipolar and multi-level encoding, power spectra of multi-level PAM signals
Basic elements of digital modulations, including OFDM
General description of phisical layer of WiFi (IEEE 802.11n, ac, ax and be)
Network architectures: layers, protocols and services
CSMA-CA protocol, MAC addresses, hubs e switches
Logical addresses, routing tables, IPv4, basics of IPv6
UDP and TCP protocols (ACK, retransmission mechanisms, flow control, congestion control)
Basics of “challenged networks” and of DTN (Delay-/Disruption-Tolerant Networking) architecture
assessment_rules: The access to the oral examination is reserved to students that have passed the written part. The final score is determined by the level of understanding of the subject and by the capacity of solving elementary exercises shown during the exam.
